response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT r.name as race_name, ds.points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), race_averages AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(points) as race_avg FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY race_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(race_avg) as overall_average FROM race_averages) SELECT race_averages.race_name, race_averages.race_avg, race_averages.race_avg - overall_avg.overall_average as difference FROM race_averages CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE overall_avg.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND race_averages.race_avg > overall_avg.overall_average ORDER BY race_averages.race_name
